title: spec.skill.md create_branch call should be removed; spec must commit directly on the current branch
description: spec.skill.md Phase 11 calls create_branch, forking from the current HEAD. This is incorrect: the spec skill should commit its output on whatever branch the session is currently on. The user manages branch strategy externally. Two prior signals (a1000004, a1b2c3d4-e5f6-4a7b-8c9d-0e1f2a3b4c5d) partially addressed this but did not resolve it; this signal supersedes both with a clear directive.
proposed_resolution: Remove the create_branch call from spec.skill.md entirely. The skill should: (1) verify there is no unrelated staged content, (2) stage spec artifacts, (3) commit on the current branch. The branch name used for the spec output is the caller's responsibility, not the skill's. Update the spec rubric to assert that no new branch is created during the spec run.
